tasks.short: Supervise teaching, internship, and research work.

steps.what: Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work.

tasks.design: The geography teacher supervises undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work in person. That supervision is the act. Nothing in it is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether a student's teaching, internship, or research is sound is a judgement only the supervisor with that student can make.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human and a workflow-automation score of 0.71 are priors. The digest says research and advising stay human. Rubric comments, closed-question marking, and syllabus generators cover examinations and written assignments in other postsecondary courses, not supervision of teaching, internships, and research. This task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Judging this student's teaching, internship, or research.
tasks.human_edge: Being the person who has watched that work.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The geography teacher still supervises undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work.

reach.learn: Learn how that teacher judges a research argument in the seminar rather than a geography project in the field.

evidence.claim: Supervising undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work is in-person judgement. Marking tools and feedback tools for examinations and papers in other postsecondary courses do not do that supervision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the geography teacher supervises undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work in person. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a placement brief is missing she still supervises from the work in front of her. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this faculty later asks for a written log after each supervision meeting.
research_questions: Does this faculty ask the geography teacher for a written log after she supervises teaching, internship, or research work?

already_counted.description: Supervising teaching, internship, and research work remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still supervises undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship, and research work in person. No second record of that supervision goes away. A conservative case is a week of watching teaching, internships, and research, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, evaluate, and revise geography curricula and methods.

steps.what: Plan, evaluate, and revise curricula, course content, course materials, and methods of instruction.

tasks.design: The geography teacher plans, evaluates, and revises curricula, course content, course materials, and methods of instruction. She writes that revision herself. Nothing in that writing is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: What a geography course should teach next is a judgement of the subject. A syllabus generator used on other postsecondary writing does not make that judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Class amplify and an artefact-generator score of 0.83 are priors. They are not a reason to hand the plan, the evaluation, or the revision to a machine. The digest's syllabus generator covers other postsecondary writing. This teacher still plans, evaluates, and revises the geography curriculum herself, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what this geography course should teach, and whether the current materials still do that.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing the course, the students, and the subject well enough to change it.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The geography teacher still plans, evaluates, and revises the curriculum, the content, the materials, and the methods.

reach.learn: Learn how a coordinator judges whether one course still matches the wider programme.

evidence.claim: Planning, evaluating, and revising a geography curriculum is the teacher's own writing and judgement. A syllabus generator for other postsecondary writing does not remove that work.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the geography teacher plans, evaluates, and revises curricula, course content, course materials, and methods of instruction herself. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If last year's curriculum is not on file she still revises from the course she teaches. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether a programme board must accept the revised curriculum before she teaches it.
research_questions: Does a programme board have to accept this geography teacher's revised curriculum before she teaches it?

already_counted.description: Planning, evaluating, and revising the curriculum remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still plans, evaluates, and revises the curriculum, course content, materials, and methods herself. No second writing of that curriculum goes away. A conservative case is one geography course revised by the teacher, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.short: Hold scheduled office hours to advise and assist students.

steps.what: Maintain regularly scheduled office hours to advise and assist students.

tasks.design: The geography teacher keeps regularly scheduled office hours and advises and assists students in person. That conversation is the act. Nothing in it is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice in office hours depends on the student in the room and on what that student is stuck on.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human and a conversation score of 0.46 are priors. The digest says advising stays human. Marking tools and feedback tools cover examinations and papers in other courses, not office-hour advising. This task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing what this student needs and saying what helps.
tasks.human_edge: The conversation with that student, in that hour.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The geography teacher still keeps office hours and advises and assists students in person.

reach.task: Advise a student in a scheduled meeting
reach.learn: Learn how a tutor helps one student with the next piece of work in the meeting.

evidence.claim: Office hours spent advising and assisting students are an in-person conversation. The digest keeps advising human, and marking tools for other courses do not hold that hour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the geography teacher maintains regularly scheduled office hours and advises and assists students in person. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a student brings no written question she still advises from the conversation. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this faculty expects a note in a student record after each office hour.
research_questions: Does this faculty expect the geography teacher to write a note in a student record after each office hour?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still keeps office hours and advises and assists students in person. No second writing of that advice goes away. A conservative case is one scheduled office hour spent with students, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.short: Supervise students' laboratory and field work.

steps.what: Supervise students' laboratory and field work.

tasks.design: The geography teacher supervises students' laboratory and field work in person. That watch is the act. Nothing in it is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A mistake at the bench or on the site can harm people, and only someone there sees the work as it happens.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human and a workflow-automation score of 0.51 are priors. The digest says research stays human. Marking and feedback tools cover examinations, not laboratory and field supervision. This task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing an unsafe or unsound step while the students are doing the work.
tasks.human_edge: Being at the bench or on the site.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The geography teacher still supervises students' laboratory and field work in person.

reach.task: Supervise students on a sample site
reach.learn: Learn how that teacher watches a sample site where a wrong step can harm people.

evidence.claim: Supervising students' laboratory and field work is in-person watching. Marking and feedback tools for examinations in other postsecondary courses do not watch that work.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the geography teacher supervises students' laboratory and field work in person. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a site brief is missing she still supervises from what she sees. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this faculty later asks for a written safety log after each laboratory or field session.
research_questions: Does this faculty ask the geography teacher for a written safety log after each laboratory or field session?
